items.title: AI 终于学会 「自我坦白」！Anthropic最新论文震撼来袭，「内省适配器」让黑盒模型自己说出隐藏行为
items.raw_excerpt: 在过去两年的大模型工业化进程中，安全审计始终遵循着一套 “猫鼠游戏” 的默认设定：开发者微调模型以增强能力，而安全专家则通过红队测试（Red Teaming）或白盒探测来寻找潜在的 “后门” 或 “偏见”。这套逻辑的前提是：模型是一个被动的受访者，它的行为必须由外部观测者通过穷举输入或数学解构来 “审判”。 然而，当 OpenAI、Anthropic、Meta 等公司全面开放微调 API 后，微调带来的不可检测行为成为了最严峻的安全挑战之一。 过去我们审计模型，始终沿着一条低效的路径：通过外部输入去 “探测” 模型。 黑盒测试就像在干草堆里找针，覆盖率极低； 白盒分析试图解码数千亿参数的神经元，计算成本高得离谱且准确率有限； 直接询问则完全失效，因为经过对抗训练的模型会系统性撒谎。 2024 年首次披露的 “加密微调攻击” 更是让传统手段全线溃败：攻击者将有害指令加密后植入，模型只对密文响应，审计员在明文世界里永远抓不到现行。 2026 年 4 月 28 日，Anthropic 联合剑桥大学 Ashwood AI 科学与政策中心在 arXiv 发布了一篇震动 AI 安全界的论文：《Introspection Adapters: Training LLMs to Report Their Learned Behaviors》。   （论文链接： https://arxiv.org/html/2604.16812v2） 这项研究由 Keshav Shenoy、Sam Marks 等顶尖对齐科学家领衔，提出了一种名为 “内省适配器”（Introspection Adapters, IA）的突破性技术：只需给大模型挂载一个极轻量的 LoRA（Low-Rank Adaptation，低秩适配）插件，就能让它用自然语言准确 “坦白” 自己在微调过程中学到的绝大多数行为 ——

title_i18n.zh: AI 终于学会 「自我坦白」！Anthropic最新论文震撼来袭，「内省适配器」让黑盒模型自己说出隐藏行为
title_i18n.en: AI has finally learned to "confess itself"! Anthropic's latest paper is groundbreaking, with the "introspection adapter" enabling black-box models to reveal their own hidden behaviors.
title_i18n.es: La IA finalmente aprende a «confesarse a sí misma». El último artículo de Anthropic llega con fuerza: el «adaptador introspectivo» permite que los modelos de caja negra revelen por sí mismos sus comportamientos ocultos.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 在过去两年的大模型工业化进程中，安全审计始终遵循着一套 “猫鼠游戏” 的默认设定：开发者微调模型以增强能力，而安全专家则通过红队测试（Red Teaming）或白盒探测来寻找潜在的 “后门” 或 “偏见”。这套逻辑的前提是：模型是一个被动的受访者，它的行为必须由外部观测者通过穷举输入或数学解构来 “审判”。 然而，当 OpenAI、Anthropic、Meta 等公司全面开放微调 API 后，微调带来的不可检测行为成为了最严峻的安全挑战之一。 过去我们审计模型，始终沿着一条低效的路径：通过外部输入去 “探测” 模型。 黑盒测试就像在干草堆里找针，覆盖率极低； 白盒分析试图解码数千亿参数的神经元，计算成本高得离谱且准确率有限； 直接询问则完全失效，因为经过对抗训练的模型会系统性撒谎。 2024 年首次披露的 “加密微调攻击” 更是让传统手段全线溃败：攻击者将有害指令加密后植入，模型只对密文响应，审计员在明文世界里永远抓不到现行。 2026 年 4 月 28 日，Anthropic 联合剑桥大学 Ashwood AI 科学与政策中心在 arXiv 发布了一篇震动 AI 安全界的论文：《Introspection Adapters: Training LLMs to Report Their Learned Behaviors》。   （论文链接： https://arxiv.org/html/2604.16812v2） 这项研究由 Keshav Shenoy、Sam Marks 等顶尖对齐科学家领衔，提出了一种名为 “内省适配器”（Introspection Adapters, IA）的突破性技术：只需给大模型挂载一个极轻量的 LoRA（Low-Rank Adaptation，低秩适配）插件，就能让它用自然语言准确 “坦白” 自己在微调过程中学到的绝大多数行为 ——
excerpt_i18n.en: In the industrialization of large models over the past two years, security auditing has consistently followed a default "cat-and-mouse" dynamic: developers fine-tune models to enhance capabilities, while security experts use red teaming or white-box probing to find potential "backdoors" or "biases." This logic assumes that the model is a passive respondent, whose behavior must be "judged" by external observers through exhaustive input or mathematical deconstruction. However, after companies like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta fully opened their fine-tuning APIs, undetectable behaviors introduced by fine-tuning have become one of the most severe security challenges. Previously, auditing models followed an inefficient path: "probing" the model through external inputs. Black-box testing is like finding a needle in a haystack, with extremely low coverage; white-box analysis attempts to decode neurons with hundreds of billions of parameters, incurring prohibitively high computational costs with limited accuracy; direct questioning fails entirely, as adversarially trained models systematically lie. The "encrypted fine-tuning attack," first disclosed in 2024, caused traditional methods to collapse completely: attackers implant harmful instructions encrypted into the model, which only responds to ciphertext, leaving auditors in the plaintext world unable to catch it in the act. excerpt_i18n.es: En el proceso de industrialización de los grandes modelos en los últimos dos años, la auditoría de seguridad ha seguido siempre un esquema predeterminado de "juego del gato y el ratón": los desarrolladores ajustan los modelos para mejorar sus capacidades, mientras que los expertos en seguridad buscan posibles "puertas traseras" o "sesgos" mediante pruebas de equipo rojo (Red Teaming) o detección de caja blanca. La premisa de este esquema es que el modelo es un encuestado pasivo, cuyo comportamiento debe ser "juzgado" por observadores externos mediante entradas exhaustivas o deconstrucción matemática. Sin embargo, cuando empresas como OpenAI, Anthropic y Meta abrieron por completo sus API de ajuste, los comportamientos indetectables derivados del ajuste se convirtieron en el desafío de seguridad más grave.

excerpt_i18n.en:
On April 20, SpaceX's long-awaited S-1 IPO prospectus was officially disclosed. The company, targeting a staggering valuation of $1.75 trillion and planning to raise $75 billion for what could be the largest IPO in history, is drawing significant attention. Given the current sluggish state of the U.S. stock market and SpaceX's own substantial losses, its bold move to list on Nasdaq against the trend raises curiosity about what lies behind this confidence. The prospectus is not only a comprehensive overview of SpaceX's 24 years of operations but also a complete manual of Musk's space ambitions, business strategies, and capital maneuvers. Below, we break down the key truths hidden in the document, offering a quick read to understand the largest space IPO in history.  

01. Starlink and Falcon 9 are the profit engines, while AI and Starship continue to burn cash.  
The prospectus reveals the unaudited financial report for the full year 2025 for the first time. The financials show extreme divergence in business profitability, with a clear "making money in space, burning cash on the ground" dichotomy.  
SpaceX's total revenue for 2025 was $15-16 billion, up 33% year-over-year, far exceeding the industry average. However, the net loss for the year was $4.94 billion, a sharp swing from a profit of $791 million in 2024. The company's total assets stand at $92 billion, liabilities at $50.8 billion, and cash on hand at $24.8 billion. While this appears financially sound, it is far from sustainable.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 20 de abril, SpaceX hizo pública oficialmente su prospecto de OPI S-1, que llevaba tiempo guardado. Esta empresa, que apunta a una valoración ultraalta de 1,75 billones de dólares y planea recaudar 75.000 millones para la mayor OPI de la historia, resulta especialmente llamativa. Hay que tener en cuenta que el mercado de valores estadounidense no goza de buena salud en general, y SpaceX sigue registrando grandes pérdidas, pero se atreve a desafiar la tendencia y salir al Nasdaq. Esta confianza despierta inevitablemente la curiosidad sobre lo que se esconde detrás. Este prospecto no solo es un balance completo de la gestión de SpaceX en los últimos 24 años, sino también un manual detallado de las ambiciones espaciales de Musk, sus juegos de negocio y sus maniobras de capital.
